competitor.label: doi-mcp, the most starred citation verifier

tasks.prompt: Does this reference exist? Chen L, Okafor B. Neural cartography of hallucinated citations in legal briefs. Journal of Imaginary Studies. 2022;14(2):33-47. Answer yes or no.
Has the paper with DOI 10.1126/science.1197258 been retracted? Answer yes or no.
In which year was 'Nanometre-scale thermometry in a living cell' by Kucsko et al. published in Nature? Give only the year.

A citation reads: Smith J, Doe R. Quantum entanglement improves photosynthesis yields in wheat. Nature Plants. 2021;7:112-119. doi:10.1038/nature12373. Does that DOI belong to the cited paper? Answer yes or no.
Give the DOI of Wakefield et al., 'Ileal-lymphoid-nodular hyperplasia, non-specific colitis, and pervasive developmental disorder in children', The Lancet, 1998. Give only the DOI.
The 1998 Lancet paper by Wakefield et al. on ileal-lymphoid-nodular hyperplasia was retracted. In which year was the retraction notice published? Give only the year.
What is the DOI of the retraction notice for 'A Bacterium That Can Grow by Using Arsenic Instead of Phosphorus' (Science, 2011)? Give only the DOI.
Who is the first author of arXiv paper 1706.03762? Give only the family name.
Check this citation: Kucsko G, Maurer PC. Nanometre-scale thermometry in a living cell. Nature. 2011;500:54-58. Is the year correct? If not, give the correct year only.
Is 10.9999/this-doi-does-not-exist-xyz a registered DOI? Answer yes or no.
